Presented file
The tarball, positional-phase9b.tar.gz, has only the changed files. Extract it at the repository root.

Regression fix: The overlap came from InfoSection. It drew the graphic and a full-width text column on top of each other in a Box. It is now a Row: the text takes the remaining width and wraps, and the graphic sits to its right. This fixes the Twilight section and every other section that has a graphic (local time, sun time, moon time, moon illumination).

Phase 9b:

Twilight and sun time art widgets: both now use Glance. The receiver class names are unchanged, so widgets already on your home screen keep working.
The twilight list is a LazyColumn, so it scrolls when the widget is small.
Both refresh hourly instead of every 30 minutes, which is easier on the battery.
Shared twilight calculation: twilight times are now calculated in one place, util/Twilight.kt. The clock panel and the widget both use it instead of each having its own copy.
Shared widget code: the header, sun times row and location/time-format helpers are in widgets/WidgetParts.kt. The existing sun time widget uses them too. As a result, its header now matches the other widgets: app name, then “last updated” on the right.
New tests: TwilightTest checks that evening phases mirror morning, every range starts before it ends, phase order and colors are sane, and a polar-day location doesn’t crash.
README: 9b is marked done and 9c (clock widgets without the per-second service) is marked next.
Unused dimens removed: description_text_size, settings_secondary_text_size and all_corner_radius.
I couldn’t run Gradle in my environment, so CI will be the first compile.
